title: Why Quick-Dry Swimwear Isn't Always PFAS-Free
description: Quick-dry swimwear sounds convenient, but it can hide PFAS finishes. Learn what quick-dry means, how PFAS shows up in swimwear, and what to look for instead.
lede: Quick-dry swimwear is everywhere — and it sounds like a straightforward convenience feature. But "quick-dry" on a swimwear label doesn't always mean what it sounds like, and for some products it signals a chemical treatment that includes PFAS. Here's what the claim actually means and how to tell the difference.
